tagline_en: Rose toner that hydrates, refines and calms
tagline_zh: 玫瑰精华露 · 具有三合一用法 · 平衡酸碱性
overview_en: Natural rose extract, aloe vera and Vitamin B5 deliver hydrating and repairing benefits, provide moisture and antioxidant protection, help refine and reduce the look of pores, shield skin from free-radical damage and calm sensitivity.
overview_zh: 天然玫瑰提取物，芦荟和维他命B5有很好的补水与修复功效，提供肌肤湿润与抗氧化，帮助紧致缩小毛孔，保护肌肤免受自由基侵袭并具抗敏效果。
